kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From أُتْرُنْج (ʔutrunj), with epenthesis instead of prothesis, from Aramaic אַתְרוּגָּא (ʾaṯruggā, ʾaṯrungā), from Old Persian [script needed] (turung), from Sanskrit मातुलुङ्ग (mātuluṅga). Cognate to Classical Syriac ܐܛܪܘܓܐ (ʾaṭruggā, ʾaṭrungā).
g: mandorla, citrus-shape for a center-medallion, or the medallion itself
